name: Humans Remain — spiked timber and mossy stone circular wall
requestedScope: Create the circular wall parts from the approved design; asset production and assembly review, before replacing the live camp perimeter.

artDirection.foundation: Low, irregular grey-taupe stonework with different stone sizes, chipped edges and olive moss in sheltered joints.
artDirection.timber: Weathered oak planks of varied width and height, with rough asymmetrical sharpened points, splitting, grain and worn edges.
artDirection.structure: Substantial square timber junction posts with dark iron straps and small bolts; three bays per standard sector.
artDirection.lighting: One fixed light from upper left in screen space; upright timbers throughout the circle.
artDirection.background: Genuine transparent alpha. No terrain patch, labels, checkerboard, characters, buildings or gates.

geometry.projection: Ground coordinates retain a circular footprint; vertical height is illustrated upward in screen space.
geometry.junctionOwnership: Each sector owns its starting post. The following sector owns the ending junction post. A small overlap falls beneath the following post.

required: Verify all 16 source images exist and decode
Check adjacent joins in a full assembled preview
Verify the 16 placement intervals close at 360 degrees
validationPolicy.caution: Exact guide and placement geometry do not alone prove exact painted boundaries. Record any remaining artwork registration issues honestly.

generationMode: Built-in image generation with exact geometry guides and the approved style reference
